title: Dynamics, periodic orbits and $C^1$ non-integrability of the ABC flow
summary: We study the Arnold-Beltrami-Childress (ABC) flow in perturbative regimes near its three elementary integrable coordinate axes. Starting from a degenerate family of periodic streamlines of the limiting integrable system, we use first-order averaging to prove the existence of two isolated periodic solutions of the perturbed flow. The three perturbative regimes are related by the cyclic symmetry of the ABC vector field.
